schema.description: The root schema comprises the entire JSON document.

autoDefaultProviders.title: Automatic default-provider selection participants

id.description: An identifier for the region compatible with Region.jsm
id.title: Region ID

providers.description: Comma-separated list of provider identifiers, referencing doh-providers collection

steeringProviders.description: Comma-separated list of provider identifiers, referencing doh-providers collection
steeringProviders.title: Regional steering providers
